rules.rule: -A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -m comment --comment "common bi-directional traffic policy rules" -j KUBE-NWPLCY-COMMON
-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -d [address] -m comment --comment "rule to permit the traffic traffic to pods when source is the pod\'s local node" -m addrtype --src-type LOCAL -j ACCEPT
-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -d [address] -m comment --comment "run through nw policy api-ingress" -j KUBE-NWPLCY-4KINRQHGU4NUPUOG
-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -m comment --comment "run through nw policy default-deny" -j KUBE-NWPLCY-CI6IF47MZGRPOS5Q

-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -m comment --comment "rule to log dropped traffic POD name:api-69f97dc69b-qvvk5 namespace: weather" -m mark ! --mark 0x10000/0x10000 -m limit --limit 10/min --limit-burst 10 -j NFLOG --nflog-group 100

-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -m comment --comment "rule to REJECT traffic destined for POD name:api-69f97dc69b-qvvk5 namespace: weather" -m mark ! --mark 0x10000/0x10000 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
-A KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6 -m comment --comment "set mark to ACCEPT traffic that comply to network policies" -j MARK --set-xmark 0x20000/0x20000

-A KUBE-ROUTER-FORWARD -s [address] -m comment --comment "rule to jump traffic from POD name:api-69f97dc69b-qvvk5 namespace: weather to chain KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6" -j KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6

-A KUBE-ROUTER-FORWARD -s [address] -m physdev --physdev-is-bridged -m comment --comment "rule to jump traffic from POD name:api-69f97dc69b-qvvk5 namespace: weather to chain KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6" -j KUBE-POD-FW-OPYCAQYPWQWNQUU6
